1.title: Woman at centre of Cornell rape inquiry was 'failed' by officials, says New York governor
1.summary: The woman, known as Jane Doe, alleges she was raped by seven students at a fraternity house at the university in 2024.

2.title: Republicans Pull Money From North Carolina Senate Race As Midterm Prospects Dim
2.summary: As the Republicans try to hold their majority, the Senate Leadership Fund is diverting resources to Kansas, which has become a growing concern for the party.

3.title: Carmel-by-the-Sea Reluctantly Adopts Street Addresses After 110 Years
3.summary: Driven by emergency response needs, Carmel-by-the-Sea reluctantly adopted street address numbers this summer, igniting concerns over its vanishing identity as a beachside village.

5.title: India Faces Fresh Protests, This Time Over Voter Rolls
5.summary: Hundreds were detained in New Delhi as demonstrators expressed anger over the removal of 130 million people from the rolls. The government denies accusations of “vote theft.”

6.title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
6.summary: More than 600 schools have faced disruption as protests over standards and lack of teachers continue.
